snippet.title: Zero Tolerance Undeground (Sega Genesis) / Playthrough 100%
snippet.description:
Complete 100% playthrough of Zero Tolerance Underground, recorded in a single firstrun session. All enemies on every level were defeated, and the game was completed using Capt. S. Ishii.

🎮 Game: Zero Tolerance Underground
🕹️ Platform: Sega Mega Drive / Sega Genesis
📹 Capture: MiSTer FPGA

I'm not a professional gamer, and my playthroughs are recorded with minimal preparation. My primary goal now is to create informational content for cataloging new Sega Mega Drive games for this project: 
https://newmd.games/
